subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The army __advanced__ into enemy territory.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"advanced"** means to move forward in a purposeful way, especially in a military context. (आगे बढ़ना)

 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers **advanced** towards the enemy lines with determination.
 
 
 
• **"Retreated" **refers to the act of moving back or withdrawing, especially to avoid confrontation or danger. (पीछे हटना)
 
 
• **Example: **After facing heavy resistance, the army **retreated** to a safer position.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'advanced' **is **'retreated'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Protruded **(बाहर निकला हुआ): To extend beyond or above a surface.

 
 
• **Example:** The rock protruded from the ground, making it a tripping hazard.
 
 
 
• **Commuted **(यात्रा करना ): To travel some distance between one's home and place of work on a regular basis.
 
 
• **Example: **He commuted daily from the suburbs to the city for work.
 
 
 
• **Arose** (उठना): To emerge or become apparent.
 
 
• **Example:** A new problem arose during the meeting, requiring immediate attention.
